lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the hill country of Judah, a man named Jesse had eight sons. The eldest were tall and broad-shouldered — the kind of men the people expected a king to be.

lines.speaker: samuel
lines.text: Jesse, bring your sons. The LORD has chosen one of them to be the next king.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Samuel anointed each eldest son in turn. The LORD said nothing. Seven passed before the prophet's eyes.

lines.speaker: samuel
lines.text: Is this all of them? The LORD has not spoken through any of these.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jesse turned to a shepherd boy keeping the flock. The youngest, ruddy and quiet, sent from the fields.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Do not look on his appearance or on his height, because I have rejected him. The LORD looks on the heart.

lines.speaker: samuel
lines.text: Send for him. We will not sit down until he comes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The boy was brought in, fresh from the sheepfold. Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the sight of his brothers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: From that day forward, the Spirit of the LORD came upon David. The quiet shepherd carried a calling he could not yet see the shape of.

choices.label: Wonder what lies ahead 🌄
choices.note: The road is long and the outcome is not his to control.

choices.label: Hold fast to the flock 🐑
choices.note: He keeps his hands on the work he knows while the anointing waits.
